statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-48924: ClassUtils.getClass() in Apache Commons Lang recursed without bound on very long input and could throw StackOverflowError. commons-lang3 3.0 before 3.18.0 is affected and fixed in 3.18.0; the legacy commons-lang 2.x line (2.0 through 2.6) is affected and has no fixed release: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j288-q9x7-2f5v, https://lists.apache.org/thread/bgv0lpswokgol11tloxnjfzdl7yrc1g1. Read the Maven metadata and manifest of every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0; the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version are byte-identical, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only). Every build ships commons-lang 2.6 as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/commons-lang-2.6.jar; it also ships commons-lang3, 3.14.0 in 8.14.4-r0 and 3.18.0 from 8.14.4-r1, and no other jar contains commons-lang 2.x classes. No published build of this owner replaces commons-lang 2.6, so every build is affected.
